title: CHAPO WHITE – Polar Mint
description: CHAPO WHITE POLAR MINT STRONG is a nicotine product that delivers a potent and refreshing mint flavor. Each gram contains 16.5mg of nicotine, with each individual pouch offering 13.2mg. This product is designed to be enjoyable and intense, providing a strong mint taste for users seeking a robust experience.
